title: Who Funds Open Science? Tracking Data Sharing in Publications Across Major Funders (ICSSI 2026 poster)
description:
A0 portrait poster presented at the 4th International Conference on the Science of Science & Innovation (ICSSI 2026), University of Colorado Boulder, 29 June - 1 July 2026. It reports a cross-sectional analysis of open data sharing across ~784,000 open access biomedical research articles (January 2024 - June 2025), benchmarking open-data rates across major funders and journals using a PDF-first detection pipeline (MinerU + oddpub v7.2.3) with OpenAlex metadata. Observed rates are census-exact corpus proportions; corrected-rate uncertainty is reported as 95% imputation intervals.

This record archives the poster source, figures, and figure-generation code, alongside the conference extended abstract. The underlying analysis pipeline, datasets, and full results are maintained in the OSM meta-repository, nimh-dsst/open-science-metrics. Interactive results: opensciencemetrics.org.
